readerContract.humanQuestion: I have a real job to do in ChatGPT. Where do I start, which model and effort should I choose, and how do I know the result is actually right?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: The reader can set up ChatGPT, distinguish Chat, Work and Codex, choose a sensible model and effort when controls are available, complete one bounded job, inspect the real result and repair a proven defect on Free or paid plans.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No technical background, paid plan, model-picker access or familiarity with ChatGPT product language is assumed.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: Four separate choices shape the job: the model is the engine, effort is how much reasoning time it receives, the surface is where and how it can act, and the plan affects access and capacity. None replaces good sources or inspection.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: A Class of 2002 reunion invitation and tiny early-web-style page contain an old date that must not reach guests.
readerContract.surfaceJob: The opening chapter of a friendly current user guide: setup, first decisions, a complete worked case, verification and recovery rather than a product glossary.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I understand the controls, I can start with the account I have, and I know how to catch a confident-looking mistake before it becomes public.

canonicalTruth.freshnessTrigger: Before publication or any change to ChatGPT models, efforts, plans, settings, Work, Codex, Projects or file handling.
Any change to the ChatGPT guide's reader, scope, Free/paid boundary or example standard.
Any change to official model, effort, prompt, context, permission, skill or surface guidance.
Any change to reference-book teaching requirements.
Any change to LAiDIES public prose rules.

strengthsToUse: Answer the reader's immediate question before adding product language.
Separate verified current facts, editorial guidance and unknown account variation.
Turn evidence into a practical next move and visible recheck trigger.
patternsNotToCopy: Do not repeat an FAQ scaffold through the chapter.
Do not inherit dated claims from the exemplar.
Do not replace a connected narrative with cards and labels.

glossaryAccumulation.producerGuard: Begin with the wrong-date problem; introduce product terms only when the reader must make that choice.
glossaryAccumulation.preventionEvidence: The planned opening contains a human consequence before a model or feature name.

templateRepetition.producerGuard: Use one unfolding job, not a stack of identical feature cards or prompt formulas.
templateRepetition.preventionEvidence: The job moves from setup to source pack, route, output, inspection and repair.

decorativeAnalogy.producerGuard: Use only one four-part working metaphor and map its limits explicitly.
decorativeAnalogy.preventionEvidence: Engine, thinking time, workplace and allowance each map to one distinct product decision; the chapter states that the metaphor does not predict quality.

referenceConfetti.producerGuard: The Class of 2002 setting must expose a stale-date and privacy problem; no unrelated nostalgia is permitted.
referenceConfetti.preventionEvidence: Every period detail participates in the source conflict or final artifact.

missingMechanism.producerGuard: Show how sources, surface permissions, model, effort, artifact inspection and targeted correction affect one another.
missingMechanism.preventionEvidence: The case includes exact sources, prompts, constructed output, defect, dependency scan and corrected output.

genericAction.producerGuard: End with a usable prompt and a transfer task, not advice to experiment.
genericAction.preventionEvidence: The reader can replace the fictional sources with a permitted real source pack and repeat the exact inspection loop.

jargonBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Explain each choice in ordinary language before displaying its product label.
jargonBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: The reader first decides whether she needs words, a finished file or changes to a website.

disconnectedSystem.producerGuard: Tie settings, current context, route, model, effort, output and verification into the same job.
disconnectedSystem.preventionEvidence: The worked example revisits each decision at the point where it changes the result.

joylessInstruction.producerGuard: Use warm colleague-to-colleague narration and one earned joke after the mechanism is understood.
joylessInstruction.preventionEvidence: The old-date reveal earns the line about high effort not being a tiara; neither mocks the reader.

purposeTooNarrow.producerGuard: Present the reunion as one reusable method, not the purpose of ChatGPT.
purposeTooNarrow.preventionEvidence: A distinct community-newsletter transfer case tests whether the method travels.

mechanismBeforeMotivation.producerGuard: Open with an incorrect public date and its consequence before setup or taxonomy.
mechanismBeforeMotivation.preventionEvidence: The first section gives the reader a reason to care before naming Chat, Work or Codex.

workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.producerGuard: Separate case facts from transferable decisions in the closing section.
workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.preventionEvidence: The chapter explicitly names what transfers and provides an unseen new case.

technicalExplainerVoice.producerGuard: Write as a capable candid girlfriend at work; translate controls through consequences and avoid software-review language.
technicalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: Every technical label is paired with a plain decision the reader is already trying to make.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: Start with the simplest surface that can finish the job, use the provided model unless a picker is visible, begin at medium or lower effort for a well-bounded task, supply one source of truth, and inspect the actual result before sharing it.
causalSequence: An old reunion date creates a clear public consequence.
The reader sets stable preferences separately from current job facts.
The needed output determines Chat, Work or Codex before model and effort are chosen.
The source hierarchy and boundaries constrain the generation.
Inspection exposes an old date that the completion summary missed.
A dependency-aware correction repairs the smallest proven defect and produces a final verification table.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A constructed Class of 2002 reunion job reconciles an approved organiser note, an old invitation and a tiny website while excluding a private RSVP list.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A neighbourhood association newsletter has a changed meeting date, an old PDF and a webpage; the reader must choose a route and state what she would verify without receiving a supplied answer.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Choose one permitted real task, write its source hierarchy and privacy boundary, use the chapter's exact prompt structure, inspect every affected occurrence and issue a targeted repair only if evidence shows a defect.

analogyPlan.concept: Model, effort, surface and plan are distinct choices.
analogyPlan.analogy: The model is the engine, effort is how long it may work the problem, the surface is the workshop it can work inside, and the plan is the allowance that governs access and capacity.
analogyPlan.mapping: Each image maps once to engine/model, time/effort, workplace/surface and allowance/plan.
analogyPlan.limit: The metaphor does not predict correctness or imply that more money, more time or a larger engine removes the need for good sources and inspection.
analogyPlan.whyItHelps: It prevents four adjacent controls from collapsing into one vague idea of better AI.

humourPlan.lessonJob: After explaining when extra reasoning is justified, use 'High effort is a setting, not a tiara' to puncture status-seeking and return the reader to observable task needs.

draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: A conversational opening, quick setup, four-choice mental model, current model-and-effort guide, complete constructed case, exact inspection and correction, explicit Free/paid boundaries, transfer challenge and dated sources.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: The chapter is one connected story with embedded reference tables; it does not repeat the same callout shape for every feature.

communicationDesign.surfaceAdaptation: Make the invisible separation among source truth, product controls, action permissions, generated claims and actual artifact state visible through one complete job while retaining quick-reference tables.

humanQuestion.reason: The reader wants to finish a real task, not study a product taxonomy.
humanQuestion.plannedEvidence: Open on the consequence of sending the wrong reunion date.

usefulCuriosity.reason: A confident completion message can disagree with the artifact.
usefulCuriosity.plannedEvidence: Let the reader inspect the footer before the chapter explains the failure.

invisibleProcessConcrete.reason: Model, effort, surface and plan otherwise blur together.
invisibleProcessConcrete.plannedEvidence: Map each to one decision and then show where each affects the reunion job.

familiarTechnicalMovement.reason: Product labels should arrive only after an ordinary output choice.
familiarTechnicalMovement.plannedEvidence: Move from needing words, a file or a website change to Chat, Work or Codex.

limitationsConsequences.reason: Access varies and a model cannot infer a private or current source it was not given.
limitationsConsequences.plannedEvidence: Show the Free route, paid extension, unavailable-control fallback and excluded RSVP list.

humourSurprise.reason: A status joke can help the reader remember to choose effort by task evidence.
humourSurprise.plannedEvidence: Use the tiara line only after all effort levels and escalation evidence are explained.

betterNextQuestion.reason: The recovery habit matters more than asking whether the answer looks good.
betterNextQuestion.plannedEvidence: Teach the reader to ask which occurrences and dependent claims still contain the old value.

explanationArc.adaptation: Answer route questions early, then use the connected case to earn the deeper model and verification lesson.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: A polished guide could confuse model, effort, surface and subscription; promise controls a Free reader cannot see; or make verification sound like a vague final instruction.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: Use a complete fictional source pack, exact prompts, a constructed flawed output, an occurrence-level inspection and a corrected final artifact, with every product claim bound to the dated source card.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: A newcomer can select a route without a paid-only control, explain the four choices in her own words, catch the stale date and transfer the method to a different update job.
